review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are looking for a highly driven and experienced Remote Sales Executive who is exceptionally strong in handling customer inquiries and converting leads into confirmed clients. This is a sales-focused role. The ideal candidate must be confident, persuasive, proactive, and comfortable handling a high volume of inquiries through phone calls, WhatsApp, and other communication channels. Excellent spoken and written English is essential. Key Responsibilities Handle incoming customer inquiries professionally and promptly through phone, WhatsApp, and other channels. Understand the customer's needs and guide the conversation toward the appropriate service. Convert inquiries into qualified leads, appointments, and confirmed bookings. Conduct strong and consistent follow-up with potential customers. Handle objections related to price, timing, hesitation, competition, and other concerns. Build trust and create urgency without being overly aggressive or pushy. Identify serious prospects and prioritize high-potential leads. Maintain ownership of leads from the initial inquiry through conversion. Re-engage previous inquiries and lost opportunities when appropriate. Strong objection-handling and negotiation skills. Confident and professional telephone manner. Excellent WhatsApp/chat communication skills. Ability to communicate naturally rather than relying on scripts. Strong follow-up skills and persistence. Comfortable working with targets and KPIs. Experience using CRM systems and managing a sales pipeline. Highly organized and able to manage a large number of active leads. Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment. Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who does not simply answer inquiries. You should know how to take control of a sales conversation, understand what the customer really wants, build trust, address concerns, follow up effectively, and confidently ask for the sale. You should be commercially minded and understand that every genuine inquiry is a potential sales opportunity. Key Performance Indicators Performance will be measured based on: Inquiry response rate Lead-to-appointment conversion rate Appointment/booking conversion rate Sales conversion rate Follow-up effectiveness Revenue generated CRM and lead-management accuracy

Your role as a Mid-Level UX Researcher is not just about leading and pitching in on research, but it's all about sharing golden nuggets of wisdom that set our digital experiences on the right track. You'll be joining the band, collaborating with our UX Labs team and clients, to groove to the rhythm of user behaviors and preferences, and together, we'll create the perfect melody to help them hit their goals. Qualifications Must have: Proven experience as a UX Researcher, with a strong work history showcasing your research work. Extended experience with various UX research tools and software, such as usability testing software, survey platforms, and analytics tools. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and drive change within the organization. Strong project management skills and experience leading research initiatives. Leadership potential and the ability to mentor and guide junior team members. Nice to have: Acquired or successfully passed Related UX Courses, Certificates. Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field (e.g., Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Anthropology, or a similar discipline) or an equivalent years or expertise in the field.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform Foundations
review_candidates.description: Summary The Cloud Platform Foundations team builds and operates the core infrastructure behind Temporal Cloud, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and automation . The team owns foundational systems including high availability and disaster recovery , control plane automation , resource and namespace management , and the customer-facing interfaces that shape how users integrate with the platform—from our APIs and CLI to the Terraform provider, SDKs, and Kubernetes operator. In this role, you'll build systems that directly strengthen Temporal Cloud's resilience, performance, and developer experience . You'll work closely with engineers and product managers to automate critical operations, evolve our multi-tenant control plane, reduce blast radius, improve namespace density, and build safer CI/CD pipelines. If you enjoy solving ambiguous, high-leverage infrastructure problems and creating durable tools that help both customers and engineers move faster, we'd love to meet you. What You'll Do High Availability & Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) — Enabling continuous regional failover and improving platform resilience. Control Plane Automation — Automating operations to improve reliability and developer efficiency. Database Performance and Optimization: Our data layer is scaling beyond its current limits. We need someone who can scale it by orders of magnitude while holding the line on latency, reliability, and availability. Deployment Plane: As our deploy frequency and engineering headcount both climb, we own redesigning the path from commit to production, drawing on strong infrastructure, deployment tooling, and systems design expertise. CI/CD for Control Plane — Building reliable pipelines for safer rollouts, faster iteration, and better test coverage. review_candidates.title: AI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: AI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer The Role We are looking for an exceptional AI Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of AI engineering, product development, and government transformation . This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will work directly with government entities to understand how critical services and operations work today, identify where AI can fundamentally change them, and then design, build, and deploy the agentic systems that power the new workflow . The role is approximately equal parts AI Engineer and Forward Deployed / Product Engineer . You need to be comfortable building AI agents and production systems while also sitting with domain experts, understanding complex processes, challenging assumptions, and translating real-world problems into working AI products. The goal isn't simply to automate existing workflows. It is to rewire them for an AI-first world . What You'll Do Build Agentic AI Systems Design, build, and deploy AI agents and multi-agent systems that solve complex, real-world problems. Engineer agentic workflows combining LLMs, tools, APIs, enterprise data and existing systems. Build systems incorporating RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, memory, reasoning and orchestration . Develop evaluation frameworks, guardrails and observability to ensure AI systems are reliable and production-ready. Move rapidly from prototype to production, continuously improving systems based on real-world usage. Rewire Government Workflows Embed directly with government entities and domain experts to understand how services and operational processes work today. Map existing workflows, decision points, bottlenecks, hand-offs and dependencies. Identify where AI enables an entirely different way of operating—not simply incremental automation. Re-engineer workflows around AI agents, human judgment and automation. Turn manual, fragmented processes into intelligent, adaptive and increasingly autonomous systems. Understand the underlying domain deeply enough to challenge existing assumptions and redesign how work gets done. Operate as a Product Engineer Translate ambiguous stakeholder problems into clear product and technical requirements. Work directly with users rather than relying solely on predefined specifications. Prototype quickly, put products in front of users and iterate based on feedback. Make pragmatic product decisions balancing user experience, technical feasibility, security and impact . Own solutions end-to-end—from discovering the problem through to deployment, adoption and measurable outcomes. What We're Looking For Strong software engineering fundamentals, ideally with significant experience in Python and modern backend/application development. Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs and Generative AI . Experience building AI agents, agentic workflows, RAG systems or LLM-powered applications . Familiarity with modern AI engineering frameworks and patterns such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP, tool calling and structured generation. Experience integrating AI systems with APIs, databases and enterprise systems. Ability to build production-quality software rather than only notebooks, demos or proofs of concept. Strong product intuition and an ability to turn loosely defined problems into working solutions. Excellent communication skills and confidence working directly with senior stakeholders and domain experts. Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where the problem may initially be more defined than the solution. What Makes You Exceptional You don't see AI as another feature to bolt onto existing software. You think about how organizations, workflows and products should operate when intelligence becomes a native part of the system . You can move between conversations with government leaders and domain experts, whiteboarding a completely new operating model, and then sitting down with engineers to build the agents, integrations and infrastructure required to make it real. You are equally comfortable asking: "How does this process work today?" and "Why should it work this way at all?" The Mission Governments were largely designed around a world where people had to manually retrieve information, interpret documents, coordinate across departments and execute processes. AI changes that assumption. We want to build systems where AI agents can understand, reason, coordinate and execute—with humans providing oversight and judgment where it matters. This role is about more than deploying AI. It's about rewiring government for an AI-first world. Abu Dhabi based On-site (no remote/hybrid)
